column3: A man snuck into Kevin's apartment every night and stole exactly one sock. Always the left one.
The first week, Kevin doesn't notice. I mean, who counts their socks?
But after a month, he has thirty right socks. And not a single left one.
The officer looks at the socks. Then at Kevin.
And goes: so someone stole your left socks?
He laughs all the way back to his car.
Now Kevin chains up his washing machine every night. But every morning, another sock is gone.
So he lies down next to the drying rack with a flashlight, and waits.
In the morning, Kevin wakes up. And his socks are gone. The ones he was wearing.
Kevin gives up. He walks into the little sock shop on the corner and buys new ones. For three hundred dollars.
The owner smiles. He already knows Kevin's shoe size.
Because he's the man. For a whole year, he's been stealing left socks all over town. Every single night.
In the storage room behind the shop, there are ten thousand left socks.
And Kevin? He's his best customer.
